Installation:
Drop the content of the archive to the StreamingAssets of your Daggerfall Unity directory. The mod should be activated by default. In case there are problems with displaying some sprites, move the mod to the bottom of your loadorder. Mod will only work with 1.14.4 version of DFU or above!

For Weapon Widget users, select Diverse Weapons settings preset in Weapon Widget mod options.

Example: [Your drive]\DaggerfallUnity\DaggerfallUnity_Data\StreamingAssets\
